models_evaluated: Pediatric pneumonia severity score-based prognostic CDS (EHR-integrated)

links.outcome: Inappropriate ED disposition in randomized trial of prognostic CDS versus usual care
links.effect: Inappropriate disposition 3% usual care vs 2% CDS (adjusted OR 0.99, 95% CI 0.32-2.95); length of stay similar; adverse safety outcomes uncommon in both arms.
links.quote: EHR-based prognostic CDS did not improve ED disposition decisions for children with pneumonia.

links.outcome: Workflow integration problems and implementation barriers during the pilot trial
links.effect: Low subject accrual and workflow integration problems likely limited effectiveness; implementation barriers included reaching the right person at the right time and the pandemic.
links.quote: Although the intervention's content was favorably received, low subject accrual and workflow integration problems likely limited effectiveness.

screen.reason: Pragmatic randomized trial of an EHR-integrated predictive risk clinical decision support system compared to usual care in real clinical practice, assessing clinical outcomes, safety, and implementation factors.
